response.sql: WITH order_fills AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_fill FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.timespan), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill, AVG(average_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS time_in_force_average_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY average_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM order_fills) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill, average_fill - time_in_force_average_fill AS amount_above_average, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE average_fill > time_in_force_average_fill AND fill_rank <= 3
